snarkDownload.title: SNARK Prover Setup
snarkDownload.onlyOnce: This only needs to happen once
snarkDownload.readyBody: SNARK setup files are ready to use

snarkProving.tooltip: A SNARK proof mathematically proves the data re-encryption was done correctly, without revealing your secret. This lets the buyer verify the sale is honest.
snarkProving.beforeUnload: Proof generation is in progress. Are you sure you want to leave?

decrypt.iagonRequiredBody: This content is stored on Iagon. Connect your Iagon account to download and decrypt it.
decrypt.devModeBody: Using simulated data. Real decryption will be available when contracts are deployed on preprod.
decrypt.secureBody: Decryption happens locally in your browser. Your keys never leave your device.
decrypt.decryptingBody: Processing encryption layers and deriving keys
decrypt.successText: Decryption successful! The message content is shown above.
decrypt.successFile: Decryption successful! Content has been saved to your library.

placeBid.title: Place Bid
placeBid.subtitle: Bid on encrypted data listing
placeBid.belowSuggested: Your bid is below the seller's suggested price of {{amount}} ADA
placeBid.bidHint: Your bid will be locked until the seller accepts or you cancel. Why {{amount}} ADA minimum?
placeBid.minimumTooltip: The Cardano network requires each piece of on-chain data (UTxO) to hold a minimum amount of ADA. Your bid is stored on-chain, so it must meet this minimum.
placeBid.futurePriceTooltip: The price you intend to re-list this data for after you win the bid. Recorded on-chain as metadata for future buyers.
placeBid.futurePriceHelp: The suggested price for the next listing after you win. Defaults to the current price.
placeBid.infoNote: Placing a bid will generate a unique encryption key and lock your ADA in the contract. You can cancel the bid anytime before the seller accepts.

errors.bidPositive: Bid amount must be a positive number
errors.futureNegative: Future price must be a non-negative number
